notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.2

Login/Register
- New users doesn't need to register anymore, the steam username will be used instead
- Current users need to link his current account with the steam account (Send me message)

Customization
- Now 2D/3D Notes Speed are separated

In-Game
- Beatmap Notes Speed are now scaled by the BPM
- Now the option for showing/hiding rankings during gameplay are saved

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 Beatmap Editor/Creation changes
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.1

General

 New application icon
 Now you can import osu files (4K/7K)


Song Selection
Fixes

 The buttons for Delete/Edit beatmaps has been restored


Editor/Creation Mode
New

 You now can select an specific line of notes (Example: Select the line 3 of all melodic notes of the beatmap)
 Added "Open this beatmap folder"


Fixes

 Fixed a bug that causes the notes of the previous loaded beatmap are not deleted succesfully
 Importing osu files now doesn't require to edit the original file, and now imports the BPM and Offset values
 Metronome now uses the Audio Effects mixer

notes.title: (v1.2) NEW UI AND MORE CHANGES
notes.content:
Update 1.2 BETA

NEW
- Home Screen New UI
- Song Selection New UI
- UserProfile New UI
- Rankings now shows your current ranking per separated

FIXES
- Your level is now displayed correctly and the experience is working again
- Now the minimum level is 1 (previously 0)
- Outdated beatmaps will notify you to update them
- If the beatmap doesn't have rankings it will show "No rankings" instead
- Rankings and Performance change animation are now working again!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.6
notes.content: You can upload your beatmaps again!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.5 BETA
notes.content:
Made some changes to the gameplay

GAMEPLAY
▶️ TIMES OF TOLERANCE

MAX: [strike]20MS[/strike] -> 50MS
PERFECT: [strike]60ms[/strike] -> 65MS
EXCELLENT: 85MS
GOOD: 100MS
ACCEPTABLE: 125MS

"This means that it is now easier to get MAX and PERFECT grades."

We will keep changing these values until we find the right ones.
Please send your suggestions in our Discord community.

NEW
Intro Screen
"There is now an introduction screen that will ask you for initial setup information."

HINTS
"There are now texts during loading screens that will display hints."

This is just preparing for the next big updates!

notes.title: 1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
After some time, we continue the development.


New Mods

 Daycore (-25% tone and speed)
 Nightcore no speed (+25% tone only)
 Daycore no speed (-25% tone only)


WAV files support disabled
There is no reason to support these files because it increases loading times, and cannot be submitted in the server because by his size.

- Beatmaps with difficulty of 3.8+ are considered insane (previously was from 4.0)

 - Now the name of the beatmaps that are in the process of creation, are called in "In development" (before it was "In process") 

Fixes: 

Username character limit and registration was distinct

notes.title: 1.1.2 UI Update
notes.content:
Home UI and Song Selection UI Updated

We will continue to update the UI in the next patches.


 Home scene loads faster
 Beatmaps Downloads UI Updated
 Various buttons updated

notes.title: 1.1.1 Christmas Update
notes.content:
NEW

 Home scene now has christmas decoration!


Editor

 Now allow to set more characters (like '/-.,!)
 Now can load the osu! beatmap data without modifications in the original file!


Fixes


 The game pauses when the windows are not on focus when you can't pause
 Home Scene visualizator has no visualization with muted audio or very reduced audio volume

notes.title: Great Update v1.1
notes.content:
Beatmaps difficulties changed

We focus in this:

 Reduce the difficulty difference in beatmaps with more or less keys
 Increase overall difficulty values to make a more noticeable difference
 Focus more in the fastest notes to create a more realistic calculated difficulty


Total Performance Recalculated
Because the performance has been recalculated, you now have a new total performance based in your rankings!

4K, 7K and Standard modes World Rankings separated
Now these modes has separated world rankings and performances!

FPS Camera and game history in the Home scene
Now you can press 'Home' key to enter the FPS camera and see the Lynium history!

Other changes...


 Fixed get #1 in one beatmap achievement
 Difficulty color values have been changed
 Added open beatmaps folder to the Creation mode
 Fixed discord link
 Added most recent beatmaps button to Beatmaps Downloads

notes.title: v1.0.10 Update
notes.content:
- Now you can Order By Difficulty and search by Variants (All, Standard, Mania, 4K/7K)
- Other translate and minor fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
- We added a new Filter called "Mode"
This filter helps you to only show your preffered beatmaps.
Like 4K/7K only, Mania Only Maps, or Standard

- We fixed an error loading empty *.lym files (the beatmaps).
(Previously are loaded with no information, now are NOT loaded)

- We set in the Customize section 'Normal - 2D' velocity and 'Normal - 3D' velocity.

- In the Home Scene 
- You can press 'Home' button to display the FPS Camera
- Use the key 'Delete' to change the rotation of the visualization
- Use the key 'Page Up/Down' to change the visualization

More features will be added in the home scene soon!

notes.title: Update 1.0.8h
notes.content:
Now in the beatmaps window every Beatmap Set will appear with his Likes and Total Plays.
Also, you can Order By Most Recent, by Likes, or Plays

Show no downloaded beatmaps was disabled, it will be enabled in the future.
